name: Undertaking Advice 2
definition: Details of the advice for the issuance of an undertaking.

ApplicantReferenceNumber.name: Applicant Reference Number
ApplicantReferenceNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the applicant to the undertaking.

Obligor.name: Obligor
Obligor.definition: Party obligated to reimburse the issuer.

UndertakingIssuanceMessage.name: Undertaking Issuance Message
UndertakingIssuanceMessage.definition: Contents of the related UndertakingIssuance message.

OriginalIssuedMedium.name: Original Issued Medium
OriginalIssuedMedium.definition: Medium used to issue the original undertaking.

EnclosedFile.name: Enclosed File
EnclosedFile.definition: Document or template enclosed in the notification.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information related to the undertaking notification.

Applicant1Rule.definition: If IssuanceType is "ISSU" then Applicant must be present.

Applicant2Rule.definition: If IssuanceType is "ISAD" then Applicant must be present.

Applicant3Rule.definition: If IssuanceType is "ISCO" then Applicant must be present.

Applicant4Rule.definition: If IssuanceType is "CRQL" then Applicant must not be present.

Applicant5Rule.definition: If IssuanceType is "QRQC" then Applicant must not be present.

Applicant6Rule.definition: If IssuanceType is "CRQB" then Applicant must not be present.

IssuanceType1Rule.definition: If IssuanceType is "CRQL" then LocalUndertakingDetails must be present.

IssuanceType2Rule.definition: If IssuanceType is "QRQC" then LocalUndertakingDetails must be present.

IssuanceType3Rule.definition: If IssuanceType is "CRQB" then LocalUndertakingDetails must be present.

IssuanceType4Rule.definition: If IssuanceType is "ISSU" then LocalUndertakingDetails must not be present.

IssuanceType5Rule.definition: If IssuanceType is "ISAD" then LocalUndertakingDetails must not be present.

IssuanceType6Rule.definition: If IssuanceType is "ISCO" then LocalUndertakingDetails must not be present.
